long_biography.plain_text:
LSR Group's combination of building-materials production and real-estate development reflects the platform Andrey Molchanov assembled in St Petersburg. After studying economics, he began a residential construction business with a classmate and acquired construction assets during post-Soviet privatisation. The group grew by adding concrete, brick, sand and development businesses, creating an integrated supply chain.

Molchanov led LSR through multiple periods as chief executive and board chairman, including its public listing and expansion beyond its home city. He stepped out of executive management in 2024 while remaining a significant shareholder. Real-estate development now contributes most of LSR's revenue, with an independent chairman and a successor chief executive responsible for current operations.

uncertainties.detail: Andrey is retained as the canonical first-name spelling because LSR Group consistently uses it. Forbes uses Andrei in the profile heading but Andrey in its body text. Russian business and corporate records establish the patronymic Юрьевич, conventionally transliterated Yuryevich.

Molchanov personally held a majority stake before the latest family allocation, and current Forbes says he and his family retain control. The dossier therefore distinguishes his personal founder history from the present family-controlled shareholding and does not attribute relatives' board roles or shares to him individually.

Molchanov left the chief-executive role and board in March 2024. Current LSR pages identify Dmitry Kutuzov as chief executive and Yury Osipov as independent chairman, so no current executive or board title is assigned to Molchanov.

Forbes labels the fortune self-made and the founder-built mechanism is clear. Public reporting notes prominent family relationships but does not establish a transferred LSR stake, launch capital or a sufficiently specific business-enabling platform, so the broader Self-made category is retained instead of independent-start or advantaged-start.

Construction & Engineering describes the integrated construction and building-materials platform that created the fortune. Real Estate is the current primary industry because development contributes the large majority of LSR's current segment revenue and profit.

The structured owner field says 21 September, but the existing owner biography, Kommersant and an established construction-industry profile say 24 September. The correction is therefore proposed at very high confidence.

No reliable source established another citizenship or an identity-verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website. Organisational accounts were not substituted for personal profiles.
Politics, public office, sanctions, allegations, legal matters, controversy, private-family detail, rankings, current net-worth figures and vessel material are excluded from the biographies.
